status: Review draft: technical checks only; user reviews visual quality.
processing: PixelLab PNG frames packed in order at native resolution with scripts/pack-sprite-animation.mjs. No resizing, recoloring, trimming or hand-painted frame changes.

base.prompt: Sir Champignon, the same garden knight as the labelled identity reference, redrawn as ONE coherent full-body 2D game character per candidate on transparent background. Friendly eccentric guardian, slightly big closed pointed steel helmet with a narrow black eye slit and two tiny cyan eyes, curved dark red horsehair plume, slate blue-gray plate armor, small tan neck, practical boots. Hold a WOODEN HOUSEHOLD BROOM with red-brown bristles in right hand and a muted green kite shield with a clearly readable red cap white-spotted mushroom emblem on left arm. No sword, no human face, no mushroom head. Match the finished garden-board, mole, white rabbit and gold star artwork: chunky crisp hand-drawn 16-bit pixel contours, dark outlines, compact flat-shaded color clusters, warm slightly earthy colors, charming cartoon anatomy, clean readable silhouette, no painterly gradients or smooth vector edges. Three-quarter front view facing slightly left like the original illustration. Neutral standing start pose ready for idle/victory/casting, broom held diagonally downward with bristles beside boots, shield outward. Entire knight, plume, boots, broom and shield visible, feet on a consistent baseline. Character occupies about 100x125 pixels within the 128x160 canvas, with transparent breathing room above and to both sides for animation. No floor, scene, text, borders, checkerboard or magenta background.

references.role: Existing knight identity: helmet, plume, broom and mushroom shield.
Final mole, rabbit and star outlines, detail and shading.
Final garden board's earthy outlined cartoon pixel-art style.

standing.prompt: A very subtle seamless standing idle loop. Breathe gently with a tiny rise and fall of the armored chest and shoulders; the red plume sways softly and settles. Both boots stay planted on exactly the same ground line. Keep the broom in the same relaxed diagonal hold and the mushroom shield facing outward. Very small pose changes only. Preserve helmet shape, equipment, scale, pixel contours and colors. Fixed camera, centered, entire body and broom inside the canvas, no walking, no rotation, no background or shadow.

victory.prompt: A cheerful compact victory celebration loop: slight knee bend, proud small upward bounce, lift the mushroom shield a little in a triumphant salute and lift the broom handle diagonally beside the shoulder, then lower both and settle back into the exact starting stance. Red plume follows the motion. Stay in place, no walking or full turn. Keep the broom and shield attached to the correct hands; preserve the closed helmet, two cyan eyes, mushroom emblem, armor and proportions. Small enough gestures to keep plume and broom fully within the fixed canvas; no cropping, no text, no trophy or background.

cast.prompt: One compact spell-casting sequence returning to the starting pose: brace the feet, pull the broom slightly inward, then make one deliberate short outward sweeping arc across the front of the body as the mushroom shield tilts forward. A few small golden-green spore sparkles briefly flick from the broom tip and fade. Settle the broom and shield back into the exact original stance. This is a guardian gardener casting a spell, no sword or combat attack. Preserve the closed helmet, cyan eyes, red plume, shield mushroom emblem and equipment in the correct hands. Fixed camera and ground line, complete character and broom stay within canvas. Transparent background, no giant aura, no text and no stars or numbers.
